Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely resolved conflicting birth-year data for James Tinling by arbitrarily prioritizing IMDb (1898) over Wikipedia (1889) without further verification from additional authoritative sources. The Planner also proposed comparing ages at release instead of directly comparing birth years, an unnecessary and potentially confusing method. While the final answer remained correct, this was the first clear methodological error in handling conflicting information.
